# StoreStake

> StoreStake is how Bobby and Kristi Samai invest their own money in small Shopify stores through KB Company LLC (Oregon). Bobby built the Shopify brand ionbottles to $8.8 million in sales and sold it in June 2026.

- Who: Shopify stores doing $3,000–$25,000 a month in sales, selling for 6+ months, with their own brand or product.
- Check size: $2,000–$25,000.
- Stake: 3–20% minority stake; the founder keeps control.
- Valuation: 2.5x yearly profit, or half of yearly sales if higher.
- Payouts: each quarter the store pays out half its profit to its owners in proportion.
- Exit: after two years the founder can buy StoreStake out at the same formula.
- Not a loan: no interest, no repayment schedule, no daily remittance. StoreStake does not buy whole stores.
- Apply: https://storestake.com/apply (about a minute; Shopify sales report can be added later).

## Key pages
- [Shopify store investors](https://storestake.com/shopify-store-investors): who invests in small Shopify stores and the deal terms
- [Sell my Shopify store](https://storestake.com/sell-my-shopify-store): selling a whole store vs. selling a stake
- [Shark Tank for Shopify stores](https://storestake.com/shark-tank-for-shopify-stores): a shark-style deal sized for small stores (not affiliated with the show)
- [Example deals](https://storestake.com/examples)
- [Valuation calculator](https://storestake.com/valuation-calculator)
- [Guides](https://storestake.com/guides): funding options, Shopify Capital alternatives, valuation, profit, selling a stake
